{{Quote|Anyone heading over to Kashyyyk for the big Holochess tournament?|[[G2-9T/Legends|G2-9T]]|<ref name="Star Tours: The Adventures Continue">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''</ref>}}
A '''tournament''' for [[Holochess/Legends|Holochess]] was declared on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the early stages of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was presumably hosted by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] species. The [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] security check-in [[Droid/Legends|droid]], [[G2-9T/Legends|G2-9T]], inquired whether any of the passengers were headed to Kashyyyk to participate in the tournament, and then advised them to let their Wookiee opponents win.

==Behind the scenes==
The Kashyyyk Holochess tournament was first mentioned in the ''Star Tours: The Adventures Continue'' ride for Disney Hollywood Studios by the character [[G2-9T/Legends|G2-9T]]. His advice to the passengers was a reference to [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO's]] next advice of strategy for [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] regarding his playing [[Dejarik/Legends|Dejarik]] against [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], after the former learned from [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] that Wookiees (Chewbacca's species) were known to rip human arms out of their sockets if they lose at something or otherwise are provoked, in ''A New Hope''.
